headline: Butterfield Bermuda: Blanchet and Hirata share 36-hole lead at 13 under
whyCareReason: Chandler Blanchet and Kensei Hirata are tied at 129 (-13). Round 3 is underway Saturday at Port Royal.
teaser: Blanchet and Hirata lead at 13-under 129. Conners in chase. Round 3 underway Saturday.
story: Round 3 of the Butterfield Bermuda Championship opened Saturday, 24 October, at Port Royal Golf Course in Southampton, Bermuda. Chandler Blanchet followed up his opening 62 with a solid 4-under 67 on Friday, while Japan's Kensei Hirata fired a bogey-free 64 to tie Blanchet for the 36-hole lead at 13-under-par 129. Canadian Corey Conners and Ben Silverman remain well positioned inside the top five heading into moving day. The 120-player field was cut to the top 65 and ties following Friday's action, with players chasing a $6 million purse and 500 FedExCup Fall points along the Atlantic coast.
stakes: Moving day in Bermuda brings shifting Atlantic breezes with FedExCup Fall points on the line.
rivalryAngle: Blanchet and Hirata share the pace while proven tour veterans mount their weekend charge.
